newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open lower after Wall Street decline.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open lower after Wall Street decline.

text.p: LONDON, July 21 (Reuter) UK shares opened lower on Monday, continuing their sharp retreat from Friday's early record high after Wall Street extended its losses following the London market close, dealers said.
The FTSE 100 index, which on Friday suffered its second biggest point fall of the year so far, was down 40.1 points at 4,837.1 by 0742 GMT, with decliners in a three-to-one majority.

A mark-down in banks and drug stocks, which have led the FTSE's record-breaking advance this year, propelled the decline while British Telecom Plc also fell amid worries over its planned alliance with MCI .
